blocks.text: Quality Tumblr is an aesthetic originating from the eponymous website circa 2012. It shares elements with Basic Girl and 2014 Girly and has an audience primarily consisting of teenage girls. Quality Tumblr's specific visuals are brightly colored images of certain products and branding that were popular amongst the demographic. Additionally, other trends of that era, such as certain films and novels, quotes, and different fashions are included.
Many photos revolve around a single product being held up to the camera, with the background being blurry
Filters are often hyper-clear and bright, with a sharper and brighter color than real life
Food that is more related to American teenaged girl culture, such as chocolate chip cookies, processed sweets, fries, and snack foods
Beauty and fragrance products from trendy brands found in malls, such as EOS lip balm, Bath and Body Works, and Too Faced
that 2013 tumblr aesthetic by Merna Louise
